summary: Phase P0 Partner Wallet / Payouts — backend + frontend verification green. 35/35 backend tests pass: 6 original test_vendor_settlement.py (unchanged) + 6 new test_vendor_settlement_extra.py (effective_until history closure via DB check, payout-config upsert incl. method/destination/min, hold/release transitions, partner read endpoints, admin-endpoint 401/403 on partner JWT, refund-debit kind='refund' via /api/returns auto-approve) + 23 regression (test_returns_refunds.py + test_returns_refunds_extra.py + test_food_favourites.py). Partner UI at /partner/food/wallet renders [partner-wallet-page] with 4 KPIs, commercial-terms banner (Taux 12%, Hebdomadaire · Jeudi · 19:00), transactions table, Historique des virements, and sidebar entry 'Portefeuille' with Wallet2 icon. All FR words verified: Portefeuille, En attente, Solde, Payé, Prochain virement, Conditions commerciales, Taux de commission, Transactions. Admin UI at /admin/vendor-settlement renders [admin-vs-page] with Vendors + Payouts tabs; clicking Settlement opens drawer with rate editor, note field, History disclosure, Payout schedule editor (type/weekday/time/method/destination/min), Pause/Resume/Generate buttons. Payouts tab shows flat list with Pay + Hold actions on scheduled rows and Release on hold rows. Fixed minor data-testid gap on Hold/Release buttons.

ui_bugs.issue: EN switch via setting localStorage.i18nextLng=en + reload swaps the sidebar label (Wallet) but inner page labels (e.g. 'Commission rate') don't flip until the react-i18next detector re-reads language. In practice an in-app language toggle works (uses i18n.changeLanguage); only direct localStorage mutation + hard reload is inconsistent. Low priority.
Hold / Release buttons were missing data-testid (only 'Pay' had one). Added admin-vs-hold-{id} and admin-vs-release-{id}.

critical_code_review_comments: modules/vendor_settlement.py (597 lines) — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting admin endpoints vs partner endpoints vs settlement helpers into separate files if further features land.

settle_order_on_delivery writes commission_rate_snapshot/commission_amount/vendor_net_amount directly via raw SQL and then calls _wallet_write — all inside the same AsyncSession. Verified by test that a later commission rate change does NOT retro-update the snapshot (DB SELECT confirms 10% snapshot preserved after rate jumps to 25%). Good.

vendor_payout_config.schedule_cfg stored as JSONB (or TEXT) — admin GET returns it as a dict in practice (verified in test); if the serializer ever returns a string, the frontend editor should still parse it defensively. PayoutScheduleIn uses dict[str, Any] which is good.

AdminVendorSettlement.jsx — pay/hold/release button cluster was only 50% test-id'd. Fixed in this iteration (added admin-vs-hold-{id} and admin-vs-release-{id}). Future tabs with analogous row actions should get testids by default.

Partner wallet UI reads i18n language at a module scope in a few sibling files (PartnerApp.jsx: `const isFr = ... localStorage.getItem('i18nextLng')`). PartnerWalletPage.jsx itself uses the react-i18next hook (`i18n.language`) which is reactive — good. Consider unifying the pattern so all portal components react to in-app language changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (partner wallet + admin VS drawer + payouts tab verified)
